children.name: throwIfKeyNotFound
children.description: Whether to throw an error if a requested key is not found in the result.

children.name: throwIfRelationNotFound
children.description: Whether to throw an error if a requested relation is not found, or a list of relation names to check.

children.name: initialData
children.description: Initial data to use as the starting dataset for the query instead of fetching from a service.

children.name: initialDataOnly
children.description: Whether to use only the initial data without fetching additional data from services.

children.name: locale
children.description:
The locale to use for the query.
Translation will be applied to the query result based on the locale.
